label: Alcoholic drinks per week
definition: The usual number of standard alcoholic drinks a person consumes per week, self-reported over the past 12 months, with non-drinkers counted as zero.
phrasings: how much alcohol does the top 10% of drinkers drink per week
how many drinks a week is a lot
how many drinks per week does the average American have
am I a heavy drinker at 20 drinks a week
what percentile is 14 drinks a week
how much do the heaviest drinkers drink
how much alcohol does the median adult drink weekly
